- Avoid over-optimistic forecasts in early periods following sharp price spikes; model tends to overshoot and then correct.
- When sentiment is neutral (all 0.00), model exhibits persistent bias toward overestimating downward trends; adjust downward by 1–2% for 30-day horizon.
- Model underestimates true price peaks in late cycles (e.g., 28–30 days) — apply a +1.5% to +3% upward bias for final 3–5 days of forecast.
- If recent history shows strong mean reversion (e.g., 3–5 consecutive days of decline), model tends to ignore it — add a 0.5–1.0% downward correction to forecast.
- Forecasting horizon 30d is prone to lagging the true trend — especially after sentiment shifts; consider adding 1–2 days of lagged price adjustment to model output.
